definitions.explanation: A first-person pronoun belonging to written and elevated style: speeches, literature, mottoes, and set phrases. In ordinary conversation {私|わたし} is used instead.
One's own mind or presence of mind, as opposed to being carried away or absorbed. This sense survives mainly in fixed expressions.

examples.japanese: {我|われ}⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧、ゆえ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{我|われ}あり。

examples.english: Anyone who thinks they are up to it, please raise your hand.

examples.japanese: {我|われ}なき{時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧よう、{若|わか}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てて→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧おきたい。
examples.english: I want to train young people so the work continues even when I am gone.

examples.japanese: {我|われ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧{見|み}とれた。
examples.english: I was so absorbed in the sight that I forgot myself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれて→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧{我|われ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{返|かえ}った→返る：29164_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: Hearing my name called, I came to my senses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皆|みな}→皆：01810_mina⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{我|われ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{我|われ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}ち→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧、⟦{出口|でぐち}→出口：02508_deguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かって→向かう：01186_mukau⟧⟦{走|はし}り{出|だ}した→走り出す：06679_hashiridasu⟧。
examples.english: Everyone leapt up, each trying to be first, and ran for the exit.

notes:
USAGE:
Outside set phrases, {我|われ} is confined to formal writing and oratory; using it in conversation sounds archaic or theatrical. The plural ⟦{我々|われわれ}→我々：03795_wareware⟧ (we), by contrast, is ordinary formal speech.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{我|われ}に{返|かえ}る→我に返る：17406_warenikaeru⟧: to come to one's senses
- ⟦{我|われ}を{忘|わす}れる→我を忘れる：21217_warewowasureru⟧: to be beside oneself; to be lost in something
- {我|われ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{我|われ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: everyone at once, each pushing to be first
- {我|われ}⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: I am the one — declaring oneself equal to a task
- ⟦{我|わ}が{国|くに}→我が国：13449_wagakuni⟧: our country — the same kanji read わ before ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧: I — the neutral everyday pronoun
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧: oneself — the ordinary word for sense 2
